description:
Unknown mystery novelist Kim Sol has found herself an unwanted number one fan: her eccentric and quirky high school classmate, Kang Na-Ra ! Why does Sol keep falling for Na-Ra, whom she never wanted to be associated with ? "Life is magic." A very special friendship unfolds in the toy store "Wonderland."

**Original Webtoon:**     
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=841150), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12944881)

**Official Translations:**
